svg.text: Launder: a U channel 100 wide, 60 deep, 810 long, under the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: deck's front edge, with a 60 mm spout at the head end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two legs 640 tall. Tailings run to a bucket under the spout.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Concentrate box: 120 x 290 x 120 tall, open top, under the far

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end of the deck (gold walks off the riffle ends into it).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hinged lid with a hasp for a padlock; four legs 640 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Both stand on the ground 15 mm clear of the moving deck.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: box top 30 below the deck end at its lowest point;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the lid locks with the deck in place.
